quests.title: A bed of two cells
quests.ask: A short bed with old gems in front. The cell the robot stands on and the one in front of it each end with exactly one gem.
quests.nudge: Count the gems you need and the steps you take. Are they the same number?

quests.title: A bed of one cell
quests.ask: The smallest bed: one cell, with the wall right in front, and a pile of old gems on it. It should end with exactly one gem.
quests.nudge: Which lines still run when the robot can't take a single step?

quests.title: A bed of any length
quests.ask: Now a longer bed with old gems here and there. Every cell up to the wall ends with exactly one gem, with the same program.
quests.nudge: If your program only fits one bed, what does it rely on?
